meetings.title: Sprint planning - week 1
meetings.summary: The team agreed to ship the upload flow first and keep the summariser stub until the SAMSum checkpoint is ready. Speaker 2 will finish the meeting page by Thursday and Speaker 3 raised that diarisation is slow on laptops.

decisions.text: Ship the upload flow before the recorder.
Keep the summariser stub until the SAMSum checkpoint is on the Hub.

actions.text: Speaker 2 will finish the meeting page by Thursday.
Speaker 1 will record three sample meetings.

problems.text: Diarisation takes several minutes on a laptop CPU.

segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.text: Okay, let's start. The goal this week is one recording going all the way to a summary on screen.

segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.text: I think we should get upload working before the browser recorder.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Yeah, agreed. Upload first, the recorder is just a blob on top of the same route.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: The summariser returns the first three segments for now. The real checkpoint lands once the Kaggle run finishes.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: I'll have the meeting page with the minutes tabs done by Thursday.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: One problem: pyannote on my laptop took almost four minutes for a three minute clip.

segments.speaker: Speaker 3
segments.text: So the live demo should use a short clip and the long ones get pre-processed.

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Makes sense. Let's write that down as a decision on Friday.

action_items.text: Finish the meeting page with the minutes tabs
Use a short clip for the live demo

segments.speaker: Speaker 1
segments.text: Can we see the supporting turns next to each sentence?

segments.speaker: Speaker 2
segments.text: Yes, clicking a sentence opens the evidence panel with entailment bars.
